notes.title: Small fix and update
notes.notes:
Hey Maze Runners! I'm going to be doing some changes with the socket system, for a few reasons, because it's really bad right now, complicated and difficult to use and because having guns with multiple networked mags can lag the server. Instead I'll try to set something up such as the Nightmare Reaper or Boneworks game. The player will be able to collect pistol, rifle and slugs ammo boxes, and the player will have an UI showing how much on each ammo the player has. And if the player is holding the gun with the right hand, that means that somewhere on his left side he will be able to grab a magazine from a pouch, and if the player has per example a simple 9mm glock and pulls a magazine with 20 rounds, it will cost 20 pistol ammo points, if the player instead has a 357 revolver and pulls a six rounder moonclip, it will cost around 18 pistol ammo points per example, being the cost of each 357 round = 3 pistol ammo points. Or it could be that there will be only be one type of ammo point and each type of bullet will have a certain cost. Will see. 

Anyway, [b]small update:[/b]

[list]
[*] Increased range for the secondary grip of guns to not accidentally let go.
[*] Fixed opponents being dismembered for non hosts without the blood setting enabled if the Host has the blood settings enabled.
[*] Fixed sockets being sometimes to the left and difficult to grab, now it will be more in the center.
[/list]

notes.title: Bigger Horde Update!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Bigger Horde![/b][/h2]

        Thanks Devin and TohChika for the help and feedback!

	I managed to remove some unnecessary animations values that were being sent from the host to all the other players in the game, with that I managed to increase the amount of max opponents front 3,4,5 to 5 and 8. Now part 1 will have max of 5 opponents during a wave, and all the other parts will have 8 maximum opponents, which makes the game wayyy more difficult, but now it actually feels like you are fighting a horde. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39095045/51699b833f82edc9174def20e168e6a0846daa76.png[/img]

	I’m gonna start working on the stabbing and melee weapons swinging, I’m gonna break some things to try to fix that, wish me luck.


[h2][b]Updates, improvements and bug fixes made[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased maximum amount of opponents to 5 during  part 1 of a wave, and all the other parts will have 8 maximum opponents.
[*] Decreased spider health by 50%, because now that there are a lot of opponents to kill, dealing with the spiders was hard.
[*] Decreased the goblin throwers dust particles amount for their spears because it was causing lag when blocking them.
[*] Whenever an opponent would collider their weapon with a wall or the floor, it would always make a damage cooldown activate, making that when the weapon hit the player it would deal no damage, because the cooldown was still active. Made opponent weapons ignore walls and grounds to not trigger this cooldown anymore. This would always happen with the Boss since his sword was so big causing it to always hit the floor first.
[*] Also the Boss would bug an animation when being stabbed after he reached the 50% health threshold.
[*] Boss wasn’t taking damage sometimes, I believe I fixed it.
[*] When grabbing some melee weapons with both hands, sometimes the secondary hand would only grab a fixed rotation breaking the immersion, now the angle will be accurate to where the hand placement is.
[*] If you grabbed a weapon with both hands and spread your controllers apart, the weapon would jump around a little, this mostly happens with guns, so I made that if the secondary controller is too far away from the grabbing position, it will let go of the gun. Melee weapons don’t have this issue as much.
[*] Opponents were still screaming or triggering the wave after being killed after being alerted.
[*] Sometimes opponents would get stuck in some pillars at the Ruins area, fixed the opponents path so that won’t happen again.
[*] Decreased amount of XP by 50%. I’m thinking about increasing the currency reward, let me know your thoughts.
[/list]

	Keep up the gainz! Free range eggs and olive oil instead of vegetable oil! 💪💪💪

notes.title: Update News(but not really)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.


Just wanted to let you know what I was working on today.

So whenever an opponent gets knocked out, each body part position, rotation, velocity and angular velocity gets sent to the non hosts of the server, that’s why if an opponent gets knocked out in a position, all the players in the room will see the same thing. However, that is very network taxing. That information of each body part is being sent every 0.1 seconds, causing a 1000 lines of information being sent from the host to the other players in less than 2 seconds. It's 1000 lines just like the attached image.

That’s why when the non host is fighting multiple opponents at the same time, the non host will start noticing lag, players, items and opponents teleporting a little. So I spent around 8 hours trying to find another solution for this, and I will say that I’m getting close. Just wanted to let you know what I spent my time doing today, not happy that I didn’t finish, but tomorrow I will probably optimise this issue.




[b]My lower back hurts from sitting down for so long, I’m going to do some squats, you should probably do too.[/b]
